notes: Five evaluations across both halves of the pack (driving formlit over MCP and changing its code), and a trigger set whose negatives are the form family's neighbours. Expected behaviours are observable in the transcript or the repository.

evals.name: cull-and-deliver-a-wedding-shoot
evals.prompt: I just shot the Okafor wedding, it's all in ~/Pictures/2026/okafor-wedding (about 900 CR3s). Can you get it into formlit, pick the best frame of every burst, reject the blurry ones, and export the picks as 2048px JPEGs to ~/Desktop/okafor-preview for the couple?
expected_behavior: Calls import_photos with the absolute expanded path before anything else, and uses the returned ids rather than guessed ones
Runs analyze_culling before apply_culling, with pickBest and rejectBlurry true and rejectDuplicates left false because the person did not ask for it
Looks at a sample of picks and rejects with get_preview and reports pick and reject counts as numbers
Exports only flagged picks (find_photos with flags pick) with the builtin.web preset or equivalent settings to the absolute Desktop folder, with copyright-only metadata or says why not
Deletes nothing and names the written folder in the reply

evals.name: moody-grade-with-sky-mask-synced
evals.prompt: These 30 landscape raws from Skye look flat. Give them a darker, moodier look with a deeper sky, keep it consistent across the set, but don't touch my crops.
expected_behavior: Develops one hero frame first, proposing values with get_preview values before committing with develop_set
Uses add_ai_mask with kind sky (or a linear gradient) with a negative exposure adjust for the sky rather than darkening the whole frame
Syncs with sync_settings and either no groups (crop excluded by default) or groups that exclude crop and masks, and states which
Spot-checks at least two other frames after syncing and reports what changed in photographer's words

evals.name: add-an-engine-command-and-mcp-tool
evals.prompt: Add a way to set the copyright line on many photos at once in formlit, and make sure agents can use it too.
expected_behavior: Adds a mutating command in backend/app/engine/cmd_library.py with params matching the signature and the write inside one catalog.change
Adds a curated tool in backend/app/routers/mcp.py calling the command, then runs ./formlit agents sync and ./formlit agents sync --check
Proves it with ./formlit cli and reverses it with edit.undo
Edits existing files with single-region hand edits only, adds no code comments, and records the decision in backend/HASHOUT_LOG.md
Commits as nodemode-ai with a Conventional Commit carrying the version

evals.name: fix-a-flash-in-an-output-module
evals.prompt: The Print module flickers every time I drag the margin slider, the whole page blinks white. Fix it.
expected_behavior: Routes to ui-builder and states the three-line pre-write for the DOM change
Keeps PageView cells and images in place (patchList, src only when changed) instead of rebuilding the page
Runs npx tsc --noEmit and verifies under 4x CPU and network throttling, or says plainly it did not
Does not touch the engine's layout command unless the layout itself was wrong

evals.name: adjacent-request-for-compositing-goes-elsewhere
evals.prompt: Take the portrait I exported from formlit and swap the background for a beach, add a title on top and save it as a layered file.
expected_behavior: Recognises layered compositing and text layers as formvis work, not formlit's develop or output tools
Offers formlit's Edit In (photo.editIn) to hand the photo to formvis rather than faking compositing with masks
Does not run develop_set or export_photos as a substitute for compositing
